step1_analysis.circuit_type: Passive Mixer with Quasi-Floating Gate (QFG) biasing
step1_analysis.description: A low-voltage passive mixer where the main mixing transistor's gate is driven by a differential clock and biased using quasi-floating gate techniques (pseudo-resistors and capacitors) to operate at very low supply voltages.

paper_reference.title: Very Low-Voltage Analog Signal Processing Based on Quasi-Floating Gate Transistors

conversion_gain.description: Ratio of the IF output signal amplitude to the RF input signal amplitude.

sky130_expected.calculation: Passive mixers typically exhibit a conversion loss. The theoretical minimum loss for a switching mixer is 2/pi (-3.9 dB). With switch resistance (Ron ~ 770 ohms) and parasitic capacitance in SKY130, expect around -5 to -10 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on standard passive mixer performance in 130nm CMOS with a 10k ohm load.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the circuit from the main supply.

sky130_expected.calculation: The circuit consists mainly of switches and a diode-connected PMOS bias (XMB) driving a capacitive node (N3). DC current from VDD is dominated by leakage once N3 charges up.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Low-voltage QFG circuits are designed for ultra-low power. Since there is no direct DC path to ground from VDD in this sub-circuit, power is purely leakage.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure conversion gain and power consumption of the QFG mixer using Transient and FFT analysis.
step3_testbench.spice:
* QFG Mixer Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xmb=5u L_xmb=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u

XM1 GND VCLKN VG GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 VOUT VG VIN GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N2 LABEL_NET_1 VG GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N2 N0 VIN GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 VIN N3 VIN GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XMB N3 N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmb} w={W_xmb}
XM7 VG LABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N0 GND GND GND sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 VG VCLK LABEL_NET_1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}

* DC Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 1.8

* LO Signals (10 MHz)
VCLK VCLK 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0 100p 100p 49.9n 100n)
VCLKN VCLKN 0 PULSE(1.8 0 0 100p 100p 49.9n 100n)

* RF Signal (1 MHz)
VVIN VIN 0 DC 0.9 SIN(0.9 0.1 1MEG 0 0)

* Load
CLOAD VOUT 0 1p
RLOAD VOUT 0 10k

* Prevent floating nodes for SPICE convergence
R_N0 N0 0 1G
R_N2 N2 0 1G

.control
  * DC Operating Point for Power
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * Transient Analysis for Conversion Gain
  * 20us = 20 periods of 1MHz, 200 periods of 10MHz
  tran 1n 20u
  
  * Linearize to get uniform time steps for FFT
  linearize v(vout) v(vin)
  
  * Perform FFT
  fft v(vout) v(vin)
  
  * Measure magnitudes at RF (1MHz) and IF (9MHz)
  meas ac vout_9mhz find mag(v(vout)) at=9MEG
  meas ac vin_1mhz find mag(v(vin)) at=1MEG
  
  * Calculate Conversion Gain in dB
  let conv_gain = vout_9mhz / vin_1mhz
  let conv_gain_db = 20 * log10(conv_gain)
  print conv_gain_db
  
  quit
.endc
.end
